g.text: Each stage reads the previous stage's output directory and writes its own
Labelled: named by their labels. Ones that
can't be labelled go to __invalid__/ for review
Each stage carries the metadata, manifests
and fields through to the next
Accessions are built in __build__/ and moved into place once complete, so a later stage never sees a partial one. --unlink-source removes a stage's input once its output is saved.
